C0887.title: Unauthorized Access Vulnerability in Driving Training System Exposes Millions of Student Records in Guangzhou
C0887.summary: During a 2022 inspection, Guangzhou police discovered that a driving training platform app developed by a tech company stored over 10.7 million student personal information records, including names, ID numbers, and phone numbers.
